title: One line of capability/records/*.jsonl
description: Each line of a records file is one JSON object of this shape. Files are append-only: a correction is a new line whose supersedes names the record it replaces. capability/tools/levels.mjs enforces this schema.

skill_id.description: The id of a skill file under skills/.

skill_sha.description: The git blob SHA of the skill file the event is about.

commit.description: The repository commit the event ran against.

result.description: check and eval_run: pass or fail. pr_use: pass, or revoked when a later line takes the use back.

evidence.description: A pointer to the evidence: a CI run, a review comment, a file. Evidence from client work stays private and is not linked.

written_by.description: check: checker; eval_run: tool; pr_use: review. Never the skill's writer.

writer_session.description: The session or run that wrote the line.

supersedes.description: The record_id of an earlier line this one replaces.

agent.description: check: the checker role (the skill's owners.checker).

judge.description: eval_run: only tool runs count toward Tested; rubric runs are shown apart; heuristic runs never count.

command.description: eval_run: the command that was run.

n.description: eval_run: number of cases; Tested needs at least 3.

key.description: pr_use: only a key-1 verdict counts.
